articles.title_en: Work from Home before and after the COVID-19 Outbreak
articles.abstract_en: Based on novel survey data, we document a persistent rise in work from home (WFH) over the course of the COVID-19 pandemic. Using theory and direct survey evidence, we argue that three-quarters of this increase reflects the adoption of new work arrangements that will likely be permanent for many workers. A quantitative model matched to survey data predicts that twice as many workers will WFH full-time postpandemic compared to prepandemic, and that one in every five instead of seven workdays will be WFH. These model predictions are consistent with survey evidence on workers’ own expectations about WFH in the future. (JEL I12, I18, J22, M54)
articles.abstract_cn: 基于新颖的调查数据，我们记录了在COVID-19疫情期间居家办公（WFH）的持续上升。利用理论和直接调查证据，我们认为这一增长的四分之三反映了新工作安排的采用，这些安排对许多工人来说可能是永久性的。与调查数据匹配的定量模型预测，疫情后全职居家办公的工人数量将是疫情前的两倍，并且每五个工作日中有一个（而非每七个工作日中有一个）将在家办公。这些模型预测与工人对未来居家办公期望的调查证据一致。（JEL I12, I18, J22, M54）

articles.title_en: Product Variety, the Cost of Living, and Welfare across Countries
articles.title_cn: 产品多样性、生活成本与跨国福利
articles.abstract_en: We use the structure of the Melitz (2003) model to compute the cost of living and welfare across 47 countries, and compare these to conventional measures of prices and real consumption from the International Comparisons Project (ICP). The cost of living is inferred without directly using ICP prices of traded goods and instead relying on output prices, openness, domestic trade costs, and product variety measured by the counts of barcodes or firms. We find that welfare relative to the United States is lower than indicated by real consumption for most countries, but similar in China and Japan and similar or higher in some European countries. (JEL E21, E23, E31, O11)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用Melitz（2003）模型的结构来计算47个国家的生活成本和福利，并将其与国际比较项目（ICP）的传统价格和实际消费度量进行比较。生活成本的推断不直接使用ICP的贸易品价格，而是依赖于产出价格、开放度、国内贸易成本以及通过条形码或企业数量衡量的产品多样性。我们发现，相对于美国，大多数国家的福利低于实际消费所显示的水平，但在中国和日本相似，在一些欧洲国家则相似或更高。（JEL E21, E23, E31, O11）

articles.title_en: Electricity and Firm Productivity: A General-Equilibrium Approach
articles.title_cn: 电力与企业生产率：一种一般均衡方法
articles.abstract_en: Many policymakers view power outages as a major constraint on firm productivity in developing countries. Yet empirical studies find modest short-run effects of outages on firm performance. This paper builds a dynamic macroeconomic model to study the long-run general-equilibrium effects of power outages on productivity. Outages lower productivity in the model by creating idle resources, depressing the scale of incumbent firms and reducing entry of new firms. Consistent with the empirical literature, the model predicts small short-run effects of eliminating outages. However, the long-run general-equilibrium effects are much larger, supporting the view that eliminating outages is an important development objective. (JEL D22, D24, G32, L94, O13, O14)
articles.abstract_cn: 许多政策制定者认为停电是发展中国家企业生产率的主要制约因素。然而，实证研究发现停电对企业绩效的短期影响有限。本文构建了一个动态宏观经济模型，以研究停电对生产率的长期一般均衡效应。在该模型中，停电通过创造闲置资源、压低现有企业规模并减少新企业进入来降低生产率。与实证文献一致，该模型预测消除停电的短期效应较小。然而，长期一般均衡效应要大得多，这支持了消除停电是重要发展目标的观点。(JEL D22, D24, G32, L94, O13, O14)

articles.abstract_en: Fiscal devaluations—an increase in import tariffs and export subsidies (IX) or an increase in value-added taxes and payroll subsidies (VP)—have been shown to provide as much stimulus under fixed exchange rates as a currency devaluation. We find that if agents expect policies to be reversed and the tax pass-through is large, VP is contractionary and IX provides a modest boost. In our medium-scale DSGE model, both features are crucial in accounting for Germany’s underperformance in response to VP in 2007. These findings cast doubt on fiscal devaluations as a cyclical stabilization tool when monetary policy is constrained. (JEL E32, E52, E62, F13, F33, H20)
articles.abstract_cn: 财政贬值——提高进口关税和出口补贴（IX）或提高增值税和工资补贴（VP）——已被证明在固定汇率下能提供与货币贬值相当的刺激。我们发现，如果代理人预期政策将被逆转且税收传导效应较大，则VP具有紧缩效应，而IX仅提供适度的提振。在我们的中等规模DSGE模型中，这两个特征对于解释德国在2007年对VP反应不佳至关重要。这些发现对财政贬值作为货币政策受限时的周期性稳定工具提出了质疑。（JEL E32, E52, E62, F13, F33, H20）

articles.title_en: Monetary Policy in Sudden Stop-Prone Economies
articles.title_cn: 突然停止倾向经济体中的货币政策
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a parsimonious theory explaining the cyclicality of monetary policy in emerging countries in a model where access to foreign financing depends on the real exchange rate and the government lacks commitment. The discretionary monetary policy is procyclical to mitigate balance sheet effects originating from exchange rate depreciations during sudden stops. Committing to an inflation targeting regime is found to increase social welfare and reduce the frequency of financial crises despite increasing their severity. Finally, the ability to use capital controls induces a less procyclical discretionary monetary policy and delivers higher welfare gains than an inflation targeting regime. (JEL E31, E32, E44, E52, F31, F33, F38)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个简约理论，解释了新兴国家货币政策的周期性，在一个外国融资获取取决于实际汇率且政府缺乏承诺的模型中。相机抉择的货币政策是顺周期的，以减轻在突然停止期间由汇率贬值引起的资产负债表效应。研究发现，承诺通胀目标制度能增加社会福利并减少金融危机的频率，尽管增加了其严重性。最后，使用资本管制的能力导致较不顺周期的相机抉择货币政策，并比通胀目标制度带来更高的福利收益。(JEL E31, E32, E44, E52, F31, F33, F38)

articles.title_en: Taxation of Consumption and Labor Income: A Quantitative Approach
articles.title_cn: 消费与劳动收入征税：一种定量方法
articles.abstract_en: I quantitatively characterize optimal consumption and labor income taxes in a structural life-cycle model of household consumption, saving, and employment choices that allows for irreversibility of durable goods and preference heterogeneity. I find that durables should be subsidized and nondurables should be taxed at a uniform rate. The durable subsidy is driven by the life-cycle features of the model together with durables’ irreversibility and borrowing constraints. Uniform taxation on nondurables holds under exogenous and endogenous—fully or weakly separable—labor supply and it relies on homogeneity of intertemporal preferences. Allowing for government’s equity concerns, I show that the model rationalizes the tax practice. (JEL D15, G51, H21, H23, H24, H31, J22)
articles.abstract_cn: 我在一个包含家庭消费、储蓄和就业选择的结构性生命周期模型中，定量刻画了最优消费和劳动收入税，该模型允许耐用品不可逆性和偏好异质性。我发现耐用品应获得补贴，而非耐用品应按统一税率征税。耐用品补贴由模型的生命周期特征以及耐用品的不可逆性和借贷约束共同驱动。在劳动供给外生和内生（完全或弱可分）的情况下，非耐用品的统一征税均成立，并且依赖于跨期偏好的同质性。考虑到政府的公平关切，我表明该模型能够合理化税收实践。（JEL D15, G51, H21, H23, H24, H31, J22）

articles.title_en: Disentangling COVID-19, Economic Mobility, and Containment Policy Shocks
articles.title_cn: 解析COVID-19、经济流动性与防控政策冲击
articles.abstract_en: We study the dynamic interaction between COVID-19, economic mobility, and containment policy. We use Bayesian panel structural vector autoregressions with daily data for 44 countries, identified through traditional and narrative sign restrictions. We find that incidence shocks and containment shocks have large and persistent effects on mobility, morbidity, and mortality that last for one to two months. These shocks are the main drivers of the pandemic, explaining between 20 and 60 percent of the average and historical variability in mobility, cases, and deaths worldwide. The policy trade-off associated to nonpharmaceutical interventions is 1 pp less economic mobility per day for 8 percent fewer deaths after 3 months. (JEL C43, H51, I12, I18, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了COVID-19、经济流动性与防控政策之间的动态相互作用。我们使用44个国家的日度数据，通过传统和叙事符号约束识别的贝叶斯面板结构向量自回归模型。我们发现，发病率冲击和防控冲击对流动性、发病率和死亡率具有持续一至两个月的大而持久的影响。这些冲击是大流行的主要驱动因素，解释了全球流动性、病例和死亡的平均及历史变异的20至60%。与非药物干预相关的政策权衡是，每天减少1个百分点的经济流动性，8%个月后死亡人数减少3。(JEL C43, H51, I12, I18, O15)

articles.title_en: “Quick Response” Economic Stimulus: The Effect of Small-Value Digital Coupons on Spending
articles.title_cn: “快速响应”经济刺激：小额数字优惠券对消费的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study a new consumption stimulus program implemented by a large Chinese city that leverages mobile payment platforms to dispense massive amounts of small-value digital coupons. Exploiting a “rush” design of the dispensing process in which over 1 million program participants compete for coupons on a first-come, first-served basis through a digital portal, we estimate that winning coupons increases weekly out-of-pocket spending by US$3 for every US$1 in government subsidy. Coupon-winning consumers practice inter-temporal substitution by moving up purchases that would have been made four months in the future. Customer flow analysis suggests that coupons distort consumption toward pricier options. (JEL D15, E21, E42, H71, O18, P25, P36)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个由中国大城市实施的新型消费刺激计划，该计划利用移动支付平台发放大量小额数字优惠券。利用发放过程中的“抢购”设计，超过1百万计划参与者在数字门户上以先到先得的方式竞争优惠券，我们估计赢得优惠券会使每周自付支出增加，每获得政府补贴US$1，支出增加US$3。赢得优惠券的消费者通过将未来四个月才会进行的购买提前来实现跨期替代。客流分析表明，优惠券将消费扭曲向更昂贵的选择。(JEL D15, E21, E42, H71, O18, P25, P36)

articles.title_en: Schooling, Skill Demand, and Differential Fertility in the Process of Structural Transformation
articles.title_cn: 结构转型过程中的教育、技能需求与差异化生育
articles.abstract_en: Demography and structural transformation are interrelated, and depend critically on education. At the turn of the twentieth century, US parents began having fewer children while increasing educational investment per child. This quantity-quality tradeoff facilitated job reallocation from the low-skilled agricultural sector to the high-skilled nonagricultural sector. This transformation is examined in a heterogeneous agent model with a nondegenerate human capital distribution, focusing on how fertility and education decisions affect structural transformation. The result shows that the quantity-quality decisions account for up to approximately one-third of the decline in the agricultural employment share. (JEL E24, I21, I26, J11, J13, J24, N31)
articles.abstract_cn: 人口统计与结构转型相互关联，且关键取决于教育。在二十世纪之交，美国父母开始减少生育数量，同时增加每个孩子的教育投资。这种数量-质量权衡促进了就业从低技能的农业部门向高技能的非农业部门重新配置。本文在一个具有非退化人力资本分布的异质性主体模型中考察了这一转型，重点关注生育和教育决策如何影响结构转型。结果表明，数量-质量决策解释了农业就业份额下降的约三分之一。（JEL E24, I21, I26, J11, J13, J24, N31）

articles.title_en: Overpersistence Bias in Individual Income Expectations and Its Aggregate Implications
articles.title_cn: 个人收入预期中的过度持续性偏差及其总体影响
articles.abstract_en: Using microlevel data, we document systematic forecast errors in household income expectations that are related to the level of income. We show that these errors can be formalized by a modest deviation from rational expectations, where agents overestimate the persistence of their income process. We then investigate the implications of these distortions on consumption and savings behavior and find two effects. First, these distortions allow an otherwise fully optimization-based quantitative model to match the joint distribution of liquid assets and income. Second, the bias alters the distribution of marginal propensities to consume which makes government stimulus policies less effective. (JEL D84, E21, D91, E62, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用微观层面数据，我们记录了家庭收入预期中与收入水平相关的系统性预测误差。我们表明，这些误差可以通过对理性预期的适度偏离来形式化，其中个体高估其收入过程的持续性。然后，我们研究了这些扭曲对消费和储蓄行为的影响，并发现了两个效应。第一，这些扭曲使得一个完全基于优化的定量模型能够匹配流动资产和收入的联合分布。第二，这种偏差改变了边际消费倾向的分布，使得政府刺激政策效果减弱。(JEL D84, E21, D91, E62, G51)

articles.abstract_en: The amount of information produced about firms’ productivities and about the quality of collateral backing their loans varies over time. These information dynamics determine the evolution of credit, output and productivity, which feeds back into incentives to produce information. We characterize this intricate dynamic relation. A credit boom happens when information about collateral depreciates. A financial crisis happens when information about collateral is suddenly generated. Information about firms’ individual productivities over credit booms can prevent or tame the crisis, acting as an endogenous macroprudential force. (JEL D24, D83, E32, E44, G01, G32)
articles.abstract_cn: 关于企业生产率及其贷款抵押品质量的信息量随时间而变化。这些信息动态决定了信贷、产出和生产率的演变，进而反馈到生产信息的激励上。我们刻画了这一复杂的动态关系。当关于抵押品的信息贬值时，信贷繁荣发生。当关于抵押品的信息突然产生时，金融危机发生。在信贷繁荣期间，关于企业个体生产率的信息可以预防或缓和危机，起到内生宏观审慎力量的作用。(JEL D24, D83, E32, E44, G01, G32)

articles.title_cn: 宏观金融稳定的最优政策
articles.abstract_en: There is a new and now large literature analyzing government policies for financial stability based on models with endogenous borrowing constraints. These normative analyses build upon the concept of constrained efficient allocation where the social planner is constrained by the same borrowing limit that agents face. In this paper, we show that there exists at least one set of tools implementing the constrained efficient allocation that can also be used by a Ramsey planner to replicate an unconstrained allocation, achieving higher welfare. Constrained efficiency may lead to inaccurate characterizations of welfare maximizing policies relative to Ramsey optimal policy. (JEL E32, E44, E61, G01, H21)
articles.abstract_cn: 有一个新的且现在庞大的文献，基于内生借款约束的模型分析政府金融稳定政策。这些规范分析建立在约束有效配置的概念之上，其中社会计划者受到与代理人相同的借款限制。在本文中，我们表明存在至少一套工具，可以实施约束有效配置，同时拉姆齐计划者也可以使用这些工具来复制无约束配置，实现更高的福利。相对于拉姆齐最优政策，约束效率可能导致对福利最大化政策的不准确描述。(JEL E32, E44, E61, G01, H21)
